exposure: breast feeding in front of others
outcome: beliefs about breastfeeding in front of others
finding: Saudi women aged 25-30, with lower education levels, and with parity 2-4 were more likely to hold traditional beliefs and practices related to newborn care and postpartum activity.
mod_finding: Women who had a normal vaginal birth were less likely to use kofalayas, while those with cesarean delivery were more likely to avoid colostrum feeding.
